_comment: Garden, coast (wide plate), coast again further down, then back into the original garden bushes. The closing garden is the same plate as the opening one, so it belongs to the same painting rather than arriving from somewhere else.

segments._: garden lead-in - dense forest bank on the left, grassy hills on the right, held consistently the whole plate. Adds real length to the opening instead of repeating a short band
garden on both sides at first, sand only starting to show partway through - bridges into coast-wide.png. Rows before 700 don't match left to right, so this is the full usable band

the coast, in one pass - beach widest first, then further down to the boats and the island offshore. Was two segments both rendering the same full plate back to back, which repeated the same painting twice
coast fades into garden, the lake and dam, then the road returns to forest in the plate's own tail - closing garden and where the drive comes to rest
